name: Golden Barber
observations: Native113: black fascia with large yellow GOLDEN BARBER wording and smaller yellow opening/contact line.
Lower dark-framed display and door contain light graphics and a barber-pole motif.
Red-brick upper storey has light rectangular/sash-like windows under brick arches; pitched grey roof and large chimneys.
Small black cafe-style table/chairs on stepped pavement at image-left.
Side brick door and metal railing/timber fencing border the brook-side gap.
Native113 is April2023, distinct from newer nearby views; keep its dated shop state explicit.
